summary: A sponsor brings the refund bill to the floor while the affected industries are still lobbying members.
realLife: Oregon’s beverage and container industries lobbied against the 1971 measure that passed both chambers and reached Governor McCall.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: bill stage and dated industry contacts.

turns.what: The clerk sends the adopted bill to the governor.
turns.pulledBy: Both chambers have approved the same version.
turns.writesBack: The governor receives the enrolled measure.

turns.what: A sponsor seeking repeal asks the same offices to record where they now stand.
turns.pulledBy: A repeal sponsor needs commitments before requesting a floor date.
turns.writesBack: The count distinguishes members contacted from members committed.
